flipToBack.prose: Flip if Jedi OCCUPY two non-Mapuzo sites (occupiesWith count 2: two sites, each occupied by owner and having a Jedi there).

children.req: occupiesWith: 2 locations occupied with actor there

flipToFront.prose: Flips back if Jedi do NOT occupy two non-Mapuzo sites (exact negation, same occupiesWith call).

children.req: occupiesWith: 2 locations occupied with actor there

requirementSemantics: flipToBack and flipToFront: symmetric OCCUPY-WITH law - 2 sites that are not Mapuzo locations (any site type, battleground NOT required), owner occupies each, and a Jedi (Filters.Jedi - includes Jedi survivors) is at each
note: deploy restriction bans Jedi EXCEPT Jedi survivors, so in practice the occupying Jedi are Jedi survivors, but the flip check itself is plain Filters.Jedi
back Force-loss rider uses a DIFFERENT location filter: end of opponent's turn + Jedi occupy two BATTLEGROUND sites (Filters.battleground_site, no spot override) -> opponent loses 1 Force
typedIdentities: restrictions (both sides): may not deploy Filters.and(Filters.generic, Filters.location), Filters.Anakin, Filters.and(Filters.Jedi, Filters.not(Filters.Jedi_Survivor)); may not play Filters.A_Jedis_Resilience; ModifyGameTextType.WEAPON_LEVITATION_MAY_NOT_STEAL_WEAPONS on Filters.Weapon_Levitation
front-only: may not play Filters.Nabrun_Leids; ForceDrainModifier(Filters.Mapuzo_site, -1, playerId) (your drains at Mapuzo sites -1)

back: Filters.Jedi_Survivor deploy -1; Filters.and(Filters.opponents(self), Filters.character, Filters.abilityMoreThan(4)) total battle destiny -1; Filters.and(Filters.your(playerId), Filters.holocron) about to leave table -> Used Pile; relocate Filters.Jedi between Filters.Jabiim_site and Filters.battleground_site for 2 Force
setupAndPullRoutes: On deploy: deploy Mining Village, Safehouse, Underground Corridor, and Fallen Order from Reserve Deck [src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/cards/set226/light/Card226_028.java:50-81]

Front+Back, once per turn: deploy a Jabiim location from Reserve Deck (THE_HIDDEN_PATH__DOWNLOAD_LOCATION, shared id) [src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/cards/set226/light/Card226_028.java:106-122, src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/cards/set226/light/Card226_028_BACK.java:143-159]

Front only, once per turn: deploy a holocron from Reserve Deck (THE_HIDDEN_PATH__DOWNLOAD_HOLOCRON) [src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/cards/set226/light/Card226_028.java:124-139]
otherObligations: Remainder of game (both sides): may not deploy generic locations, Anakin, or Jedi except Jedi survivors; may not play A Jedi's Resilience; Weapon Levitation may not steal weapons [src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/cards/set226/light/Card226_028.java:84-100, src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/cards/set226/light/Card226_028_BACK.java:61-80]
Front: may not play Nabrun Leids; your Force drains at Mapuzo sites are -1 [src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/cards/set226/light/Card226_028.java:97-99]

Back: Jedi survivors deploy -1; opponent's total battle destiny -1 where they have a character of ability > 4 [src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/cards/set226/light/Card226_028_BACK.java:76-77]
Back: your holocron about to leave table is placed in Used Pile instead (required) [src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/cards/set226/light/Card226_028_BACK.java:88-106]
Back: end of opponent's turn, if Jedi occupy two battleground sites, opponent loses 1 Force [src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/cards/set226/light/Card226_028_BACK.java:109-119]

Back: during your move phase, may use 2 Force to relocate a Jedi between a Jabiim site and a battleground site as a regular move [src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/cards/set226/light/Card226_028_BACK.java:161-225]
